extraction.notes: No official 2027 camp information was found. Dates below are from the supplied 2026 camp lineup; its introductory registration announcement establishes the year for dates printed without a year. The registration platform returned no readable text, so availability could not be checked. Johnson City sites are retained for AVLGO's drive-time check. Prices whose billing unit is not explicitly stated use unit other. The May 28 football skill clinic is included as a summer-season clinic; the May 15 cheer clinic is excluded as a spring offering.

excluded.reason: A different provider, Johnson City Central School District in New York, not Johnson City Parks & Recreation in Tennessee.
